source_text:
Ἐὰν δὲ λέγωμεν τὸ ὑπὲρ ἃ γέγραπται εἶναί τινα, οὐ τοῦτό φαμεν ὅτι γνωστὰ τοῖς πολλοῖς εἶναι δύναται, ἀλλὰ Ἰωάννῃ ἀκούοντι καὶ γράφειν αὐτὰ μὴ ἐπιτρεπομένῳ, ὁποῖα ἦν τὰ τῶν βροντῶν ῥήματα, καὶ μανθάνοντι καὶ διὰ τὸ φείδεσθαι τοῦ κόσμου οὐ γράφοντι αὐτά· ᾤετο γὰρ μηδὲ αὐτὸν τὸν κόσμον χωρεῖν τὰ γραφόμενα βιβλία.

ἀλλὰ καὶ ἅπερ ὁ Παῦλος μεμάθηκεν ἄρρητα ῥήματα ὑπὲρ ἃ γέγραπται, εἴ γε τὰ γεγραμμένα ἄνθρωποι λελαλήκασι· καὶ ἃ ὀφθαλμὸς οὐκ εἶδεν ἐστὶν ὑπὲρ τὰ γεγραμμένα, καὶ ἃ οὖς οὐκ ἤκουσεν γραφῆναι οὐ δύναται. καὶ τὰ ἐπὶ καρδίαν ἀνθρώπου μὴ ἀναβεβηκότα μείζονά ἐστι τῆς τοῦ Ἰακὼβ πηγῆς, ἀπὸ τῆς πηγῆς ὕδατος ἁλλομένου εἰς ζωὴν αἰώνιον φανερούμενα τοῖς οὐκέτι καρδίαν ἀνθρώπου ἔχουσιν, ἀλλὰ δυναμένοις λέγειν· Ἡμεῖς δὲ νοῦν Χριστοῦ ἔχομεν.
pass_a_gloss: But if we say that there are certain things beyond what has been written, we do not say this — that they can be knowable to the many — but to John hearing and not being permitted to write them, such as were the words of the thunders, and learning and because of sparing the world not writing them; for he thought that not even the world itself would contain the books being written. But also what things Paul has learned — unspeakable words beyond what has been written — if indeed humans have spoken the things written; and what eye has not seen is beyond the things written, and what ear has not heard is not able to be written. And the things not having gone up upon a human heart are greater than Jacob’s spring, being manifested from the spring of water leaping into eternal life to those no longer having a human heart but being able to say: But we have the mind of Christ.
pass_b_english: If we say there are things beyond what is written, we do not mean that the many can know them. We mean what John heard and was not allowed to write — [[the words of the thunders >> Bible:Revelation 10:4]] — learning them yet sparing the world by not writing them, because he judged that [[the world itself could not contain the books that would be written. >> Bible:John 21:25]]

So too with what Paul learned: [[unspeakable words >> Bible:2 Corinthians 12:4]] beyond what is written — if humans have in fact spoken what stands written. [[What eye has not seen >> Bible:1 Corinthians 2:9]] is beyond the written; what ear has not heard cannot be written down. And what has never risen upon a human heart is greater than Jacob’s spring: it is shown from [[the spring of water leaping up to eternal life >> Bible:John 4:14]] to those who no longer have only a human heart, but can say, [[“We have the mind of Christ.” >> Bible:1 Corinthians 2:16]]
